entries.title: Focus your iPhone or iPad on one project
entries.body: Tap Filter at the right of the top bar on your iPhone or iPad and pick a project. Tasks, Activity, the crew and the panels then show that project, and what you send to your first mate from the phone is about it unless you name another. A row under the top bar names the project and how many tasks wait on you elsewhere; its × shows every project again. The phone keeps its own focus for each computer, apart from the one on your computer, and ⇧⌘P opens Filter from a keyboard.

picture.alt: An iPad on its side focused on the north-pier project: the row under the top bar names north-pier and one task waiting elsewhere, and Tasks lists only north-pier's tasks
